text:
Everyone desires you, but no one loves you.

No one can love you, serpent,

because you have no love,

because you are dry as dry straw

and bear no fruit.

Your soul is like the skin of the old.

Resign yourself. You can do no more

than set men's hands alight

and seduce them with the promises of your body.

Rejoice. In that profession of desire

nobody can feign innocence as you do

or cast spells with your immense eyes.

translation.title: Qasida of the Temptress
